data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: spoon
sections.question: spoon
sections.summary: a tool with a round part and a handle used for eating soup or mixing food

senses.definition: a tool with a round bowl-shaped part and a long handle that you use to eat or mix food
examples: She uses a spoon to eat her soup.
He puts a spoon in the cup to mix the sugar.

answers.answer: She uses a spoon to eat her soup.
He drinks his spoon in the morning.
She wears a spoon on her head.
They plant a spoon in the garden.

sections.title: table
sections.question: table
sections.summary: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs that you put things on

senses.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and four legs that you put things on or sit at to eat
examples: She puts her cup on the table.
He sits at the table to eat dinner.

answers.answer: She puts her cup on the table.
He drinks his table in the morning.
She eats a table for lunch.
They plant a table in the garden.

sections.question: umbrella

examples: She takes her umbrella because it is raining.

sections.title: watch
sections.question: watch
sections.summary: a small clock that you wear on your wrist; also to look at something for a period of time

senses.definition: a small clock that you wear on your wrist to tell the time
examples: She looks at her watch to see what time it is.
He wears a watch on his left wrist.

senses.definition: to look at something for a period of time and pay attention to what happens
examples: He watches football on his phone.
